observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a white sewing machine with a red control panel and a digital display. The brand 'JANOME' is visible in red on the front right side.
The machine has a large flatbed for embroidery or sewing, with a metal arm and a presser foot area.
The control panel has a grid of buttons and a small screen, typical of a digital sewing machine.
The machine appears to be in used condition with some dust and minor wear.
The background includes a ruler and a patterned surface, suggesting a workshop or home setting.
No visible damage to the machine body, but no close-up of the needle, bobbin, or motor area.

risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label on the machine, preferably on the back or side, showing 'Mc 230E'.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic JANOME mini-monogram machine, not as the specific Mc 230E model, which may be worth less.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the machine powered on, needle moving, and stitching fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The machine may have missing parts or accessories (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, embroidery hoop).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label on the machine, showing the exact model number.
A video clip showing the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
A photo of all included accessories (foot pedal, power cord, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
